policies.title: New Employment Contract Digital Filing System
policies.body: All employers must file labor contracts via the national digital platform. Paper submissions no longer accepted for contracts signed after July 1, 2026.

policies.title: Gig Economy Occupational Injury Insurance Nationwide
policies.body: Platform-based gig workers now covered by occupational injury insurance nationwide. Employers using platform workers must register and contribute.

policies.title: AI Ethics Guidelines for Recruitment Practices
policies.body: Draft guidelines require employers using AI screening tools to disclose usage to candidates and allow human review requests.

policies.title: Social Insurance Base Adjustment — 2026 Annual Update
policies.body: Provincial social insurance contribution bases updated for 2026. Employers should verify their contribution amounts against new published bases.

policies.title: Minimum Wage: National Average ¥1,055/hour
policies.body: National average minimum wage raised from ¥1,004 to ¥1,055/hr. Now in enforcement cycle. Review payroll for all hourly and part-time workers.

policies.title: Childcare Leave Extension for SMEs
policies.body: SMEs with under 300 employees now required to offer same childcare leave entitlements as large corporations.

policies.title: Discretionary Work System Reform
policies.body: Revised discretionary work system expands eligible job types and tightens health management obligations. Employers using the system must update agreements.

policies.title: Foreign Worker Specified Skill Sector Expansion
policies.body: Government consulting on adding electronics manufacturing and hospitality to Specified Skilled Worker category 2. Comment period open.

policies.title: Minimum Wage +2.9% → KRW 10,320/hour
policies.body: Minimum wage raised from KRW 10,030 to KRW 10,320/hr. Full enforcement cycle. Ensure all employment contracts reflect current rates.

policies.title: 52-Hour Workweek — Enhanced Penalty Enforcement
policies.body: Enforcement agencies increased workweek violation fines. Manufacturing and IT sectors facing heightened inspection priority.

policies.title: Employer Reporting: Irregular Worker Ratio
policies.body: Companies with 300+ employees must report ratio of irregular (non-full-time) workers to the Ministry. New transparency requirement.

policies.title: Parental Leave Pay Cap Raised to KRW 2.5M/month
policies.body: Parental leave pay cap raised from KRW 1.5M to KRW 2.5M/month for first 3 months. Designed to encourage male employee uptake.

policies.title: Employment Insurance Rate Review
policies.body: MOEL consulting on increasing employment insurance rates to fund extended parental benefits. Decision expected Q3 2026.

policies.title: Employment Pass Min. Salary: S$5,600 (Large) / S$5,000 (SME)
policies.body: Revised EP qualifying salaries effective Sept 2025. Financial services threshold: S$6,200. Employers renewing or applying EPs must meet updated thresholds.

policies.title: Mandatory AI Impact Assessment for Large Employers
policies.body: Employers with 25+ staff using AI for HR decisions must conduct annual AI impact assessments and share results with employees.

policies.title: Progressive Wage Model Extended to Retail Sector
policies.body: PWM framework now covers retail sector workers. Employers must meet mandatory wage increases tied to skills and productivity benchmarks.

policies.title: CPF Contribution Rate Increase for Workers 55–60
policies.body: CPF contributions for workers aged 55–60 increased to 37% total (employer + employee). Update payroll for affected employees.

policies.title: Flexible Work Arrangements — Mandatory Request Process
policies.body: Employers must implement formal FWA request-and-response process. Rejections must be documented with business reasons.

policies.title: Statutory Minimum Wage → HKD 40/hour
policies.body: Minimum wage increased from HKD 37.50 to HKD 40/hour. Review all hourly-paid positions and outsourced service contracts for compliance.

policies.title: Enhanced IANG Scheme for Non-local Graduates
policies.body: Updated IANG conditions require employers to provide structured mentorship and training plans for IANG visa holders.

policies.title: Paternity Leave Extension: 5 → 10 Days
policies.body: Bill extending statutory paternity leave passed first reading. Expected to take effect Q1 2027.

policies.title: Basic Wage → NTD 28,590/month (NTD 190/hr)
policies.body: Monthly minimum wage raised from NTD 27,470 to NTD 28,590. Hourly rate raised to NTD 190. Effective January 2025.

policies.title: Paternity Leave Extended to 7 Days
policies.body: Statutory paternity leave increased from 5 to 7 days. Applies to births registered from January 2026 onwards.

policies.title: Ergonomic Risk Assessment — Office Workers (Draft)
policies.body: Draft regulation requiring ergonomic risk assessments for desk-based workers in offices with 50+ employees. Consultation open.

policies.title: National Minimum Wage +3.75% → AUD 24.10/hour
policies.body: Fair Work Commission increased minimum wage from AUD 23.23 to AUD 24.10/hr. Modern award minimum wages also increased 3.75%. Effective July 1, 2026.

policies.title: Right to Disconnect — Full Enforcement incl. Small Business
policies.body: Right to Disconnect now applies to small businesses (< 15 employees). Employees may refuse unreasonable after-hours contact. Policies must be documented.

policies.title: Superannuation Guarantee: 11.5% → 12%
policies.body: SG rate increased to 12% from July 1, 2026. Final step in legislated increase. Update payroll systems immediately.

policies.title: Casual Employment Reform — New Definition
policies.body: New definition of casual employee based on practical work reality. Employees may convert to permanent status after 6 months regardless of contract terms.

policies.title: Pay Transparency — Right to Discuss Wages
policies.body: Employees have explicit right to share pay information. Employers cannot prohibit pay discussions. Review contracts for non-compliant clauses.

policies.title: Digital Platforms — Minimum Standards for Gig Workers
policies.body: New minimum standards for gig economy workers including minimum earnings floor and transparency on algorithmic work allocation.

policies.title: Minimum Wage → NZD 23.50/hour
policies.body: Minimum wage raised from NZD 22.70 to NZD 23.50/hr. Starting-out and training wages also increased proportionally.

policies.title: 90-Day Trial Period Re-expanded to All Employers
policies.body: Trial periods re-expanded to all employer sizes. Previously restricted to small employers under 20 staff.

policies.title: EPFO: PF Wage Threshold Revision (INR 15K → 21K)
policies.body: EPFO considering raising mandatory PF enrollment threshold from INR 15,000 to INR 21,000/month. Would significantly expand employer liability. Pending notification.

policies.title: Labour Codes Implementation — State Notifications
policies.body: States notifying rules under the four Labour Codes on varying timelines. Multi-state employers must monitor each state separately.

policies.title: Vietnam: Minimum Wage +6% — Region I: VND 4.96M/month
policies.body: Minimum wages raised 6% across all 4 regions effective July 1, 2025. Region I (Hanoi / HCMC): VND 4.96M/month.

policies.title: Thailand: Work Permit Digitalization — 7-Day Processing
policies.body: One-stop digital platform for work permits now operational. Processing time reduced to 7 business days for most categories.

policies.title: Indonesia: Omnibus Law Employment Provisions — Enforced
policies.body: Fixed-term contracts limited to 5 years total. Severance pay formulas clarified following Constitutional Court ruling.

policies.title: Philippines: Telecommuting Act — Mandatory Policy Required
policies.body: Employers with remote workers must now have formal telecommuting policy meeting minimum standards including OT pay and equipment provision.

policies.title: Malaysia: Minimum Wage 2026 Review Pending
policies.body: Annual minimum wage review underway. Current rate MYR 1,500/month. Decision expected Q3 2026.
